trendReplay.multiplatformScope: Replay Facebook, Threads and TikTok data archived in S3; no crawling or login sessions required.

Processing writes Neo4j, Chroma and Redis like live crawling. Include 7 preceding days for a full historical baseline; older snapshots cannot overwrite newer live results.

trendPipeline.interruptedDescription: Collection was interrupted. Completed batches are retained; this run is not currently running.

trendPipeline.recoveryAccepted: Recovery from saved data accepted. Aggregation and database progress are tracked below.
trendPipeline.recoveryConflict: This run changed state or can no longer be recovered. Refresh its status.
trendPipeline.runNotFound: This pipeline run was not found. Refresh the list.
trendPipeline.confirmRecoveryDescription: Use this run's saved data without opening a browser for new crawling or forcing completed batches to run again. The worker will continue aggregation and save the results; uncollected sources remain recorded as missing. AI aggregation calls may incur provider costs.
trendPipeline.sessionMissing: A valid Facebook session is required for a new crawl. Saved runs can still be recovered when the recovery environment is ready.
trendPipeline.ready: Ready to run the complete flow using the current configuration.
trendPipeline.accepted: Pipeline request accepted. Collection, processing and database progress are tracked below.
trendPipeline.busy: A trend pipeline run is already active. Follow its progress before starting another.
trendPipeline.notReady: The pipeline is not ready. Check ingestion, queue, worker and tracking services, then refresh.
trendPipeline.error: Could not load pipeline status. Refresh and check the services.
trendPipeline.scheduleDisabled: Automatic scheduling is off; manual execution remains available.
trendPipeline.schedulerStopped: The scheduling process is not running.
trendPipeline.invalidSchedule: Invalid schedule; the scheduler uses its default.
trendPipeline.confirmTitle: Run the complete trend pipeline now?
trendPipeline.confirmDescription: Start the same flow as the schedule: crawl → queue → trend processing → database. Keep the current sources and automatic schedule. Provider calls may incur costs.
trendPipeline.historyDescription: Completion requires processing and database publication, not just successful crawling.
trendPipeline.historicalSaved: Database saved; a newer live snapshot was preserved.

crawler.loadError: Unable to load data. Please try again.
crawler.checkUnavailable: Unable to verify. Check connectivity or contact the deployment operator.
crawler.credentialsHelp: Use existing accounts and providers. Do not enter social account passwords or OTPs here. Secrets can be replaced but cannot be read back.
crawler.sessionHelp: Upload a session from an existing account. AI service keeps it only in memory; replacements apply to the next run. Upload again after a restart or deployment.
crawler.connectionHelp: Only deployment-allowlisted hosts are accepted. This may include proxy credentials; values are never displayed again.
crawler.revokeDescription: Stop using this configuration for future runs. Active runs keep their own version. This does not sign out or revoke the session on the social platform.
crawler.runHelp: This selection applies to this run only and does not change default platforms or scheduling. A small test does not update live trends by default.
crawler.fixChecks: Resolve the missing requirements for the selected platforms before starting.
crawler.commandError: The command was not confirmed. Check existing runs and system health before retrying.
crawler.liveWarning: This run collects real data and updates live trends. Configured paid services may be used.
crawler.testWarning: This test calls real sources with small limits and may incur provider charges. Results are not published to live trends.
crawler.previewSources: Facebook sources × maximum posts per source
crawler.stopHelp: The crawler stops starting new sources and preserves collected data. The current source may finish; already delivered batches continue through the worker.
crawler.scheduleNotice: Existing schedules keep their timezone. Change it only when you intend to change firing times.
crawler.retryHelp: Create a new run for failed Facebook sources only. Uses current configuration/session and existing dedup; does not requeue or edit the original run. The new live snapshot may contain only retried-source results; previously successful sources are not automatically merged.

codes.RUNNER_DEPENDENCIES_MISSING: Collector dependencies missing. Update the image through dev/CI/CD.
codes.BROWSER_MISSING: Packages are installed but the browser binary is missing. Install it with the crawler Python locally, or rebuild the Docker image through CI/CD.
codes.SESSION_MISSING: Upload the platform session under Sessions & connections.
codes.SECRET_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Secret storage is unavailable. Provision a separate encryption key file through deployment.
codes.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Runtime storage is not writable. Check the volume and service permissions.
codes.PROXY_NOT_CONFIGURED: Configure the proxy before running Facebook/Threads.
codes.TIKTOK_NOT_CONFIGURED: Configure the TikTok API or deselect TikTok for this run.
codes.TRACKING_UNAVAILABLE: Tracking Redis is unavailable; progress cannot be confirmed.
codes.WORKER_UNAVAILABLE: No verified consumer on the crawl queue.
codes.SCHEDULER_STOPPED: No fresh scheduler heartbeat. Check the deployed service.
codes.NETWORK_TIMEOUT: Connection timed out. Session validity is unknown.
codes.AUTH_FAILED: Provider authentication failed. Review the stored credential.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Provider rate limit reached. Try later.
codes.HTTP_ERROR: The provider returned an HTTP error.
codes.PROBE_NOT_CONFIGURED: A safe probe endpoint has not been configured through deployment.
codes.BROWSER_OR_NETWORK_FAILED: Browser or network failed; session validity is unknown.
codes.PROBE_UNAVAILABLE: Probe did not complete. Check browser and connectivity.
codes.EXPIRED_OR_LOGIN_REQUIRED: Sign in locally and upload a new session.
codes.CHECKPOINT_REQUIRED: Complete manual verification locally and upload a new session.
codes.QUEUE_BACKLOG: The crawl queue has a backlog; check worker progress.
codes.RUN_STALLED: This run has not reported progress recently. Check source events and connectivity before requesting a stop.
codes.NO_RECENT_PUBLICATION: No fresh trend snapshot within the monitoring window. Open View trends to inspect the data.
codes.BROWSER_DEPENDENCIES_MISSING: The crawler Python is missing Playwright/CloakBrowser. Install requirements-crawler.txt into its venv locally; rebuild the Docker image through CI/CD.
codes.BROWSER_CHECK_TIMEOUT: The browser check timed out. Refresh and check the crawler Python environment.
codes.BROWSER_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE: Unable to check the browser. Check Python, subprocess permissions and the crawler environment path.

feedback.saved: New version saved; applies to the next run.
feedback.failed: Action failed. Reload metadata and check revision, permissions and secure transport. A failed save does not replace the previous credential.

crawler.healthScope: Session, proxy and API checks verify configuration. Use Check connection to verify remote sign-in/connectivity. Ready does not guarantee provider availability.
crawler.threadPreview: Threads: {{topics}} topics, up to {{posts}} posts, {{seconds}} seconds.
crawler.sessionMemoryHelp: Facebook/Threads sessions stay only in AI service memory. Restarting or deploying clears them; an admin must upload them again. Session uploads do not require an encryption key file.
crawler.connectionKeyRequired: Saving proxy/API credentials still requires encryption key configuration. This does not block Facebook/Threads session uploads.
